title: Starry Farm Night
description: A serene rural landscape at night features a golden wheat field in the foreground, a wooden fence, scattered trees, and a red barn in the distance under a dramatic purple sky. The sky is filled with stars, a glowing blue crescent moon, a spiral galaxy, and a bright comet streaking downward.
prompt: A mystical nighttime farm landscape with golden wheat fields in the foreground, wooden fence, scattered trees, and a red barn in the misty distance. The dramatic purple sky is filled with stars, a glowing blue crescent moon, a large spiral galaxy, and a bright comet streaking across, all rendered in a dreamy fantasy painting style with soft atmospheric lighting.
